description: This file contains the class definition for Smarty_Template_Compiled, which manages the compilation, rendering, and file handling of template files within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for loading, processing, compiling, writing, and rendering compiled templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Compiled
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the compilation and rendering of Smarty template files, including file path population, compilation, caching, and execution.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates and returns a compiled Smarty_Template_Compiled object for a given template.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Generates the filepath for the compiled template based on template source and Smarty configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Outputs the rendered template code, handling debugging, cache dependencies, and uncompiled rendering if necessary.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the processing of the template source, including recompiling if needed.

methods.name: compileTemplateSource
methods.description: Compiles the template source code into PHP and writes it to the filesystem.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes compiled template code to the filesystem, returning success status.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the compiled content from the compiled PHP file.

methods.name: loadCompiledTemplate
methods.description: Strictly loads the compiled template PHP file into runtime, invalidating opcache if necessary.
